articles.title: Smaller tokens lead as bitcoin, sol rally in 'first real bounce of the selloff'
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rebounded on dovish Federal Reserve signals, with speculative tokens like Memecore’s M and Audiera’s BEAT leading gains.

articles.title: Taiko fully restores cross-chain bridge just 10 days after a $1.7 million hack
articles.snippet: The protocol completed a multi-stage recovery that included an independent security review. The TAIKO token has surged as much as 136% in recent trading.

articles.title: Robinhood rolls out public blockchain as it expands deeper into crypto
articles.snippet: Robinhood's product push continues to blur the line between crypto and more traditional finance.

articles.title: Robinhood links with dYdX Labs to launch new DEX Arcus
articles.snippet: The crypto protocol dYdX has rebranded as Arcus and is joining Robinhood’s new blockchain to bring perpetual and tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: Robinhood rolls out public blockchain, plans crypto trading for UK residents
articles.snippet: The company announced a suite of DeFi products, plans for launching crypto trading in the UK and its public mainnet after months of testing.
